column1: Registration of Deaths (Temporary Provisions)
Act, No. 17 of 2005

column2: (2) Upon receipt of an application under subsection (1),

column1: the  District  Registrar  shall,  notwithstanding  anything  to
contrary  in  the  preceding  provisions  of  this Act,  forthwith
send to the Registrar-General a Report under his hand, setting
out the particulars of the death required to be registered under
the Births and Deaths Registration Act (Chapter 110) as he
has  been  able  to  ascertain  from  the  application  and  the
accompanying affidavit and finding.

column2: (3)  Upon  receipt  of  the  Report  under  subsection  (2),

column1: the  Registrar-General  shall  make  order  directing  the
appropriate  Registrar  to  register  in  the  Register  of  Deaths
maintained  by  such  Registrar  under  the  Births  and  Deaths
Registration Act (Chapter 110), the particulars specified in
such Report and issue in respect of such person a Certificate
of Death.

column2: (4) Upon receipt of an order under subsection (3) directing

column1: him to enter the particulars relating to the relevant death in
the Register of Deaths maintained by him under the Births
and Deaths Registration Act (Chapter 110), the Registrar shall
forthwith enter such particulars in such register and sign the
register in the appropriate place.

column2: (5) There shall be attached to the duplicate of the relevant

column1: registration entry, the written order of the Registrar-General
made under subsection (3) and such duplicate and order shall
be sent together, by the Registrar to the appropriate District
Registrar for transmission to the Registrar-General for custody
in his office.

column2: (6) Where the application under subsection (1) is made to

column1: the Registrar-General, the provisions of subsections (2) and
(5) shall mutatis mutandis apply as if the reference in those
sections to the District Registrar is a reference to the Registrar-
General.
